mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, we are looking at clear skies at Verona City Hall with a temperature of 40 degrees and a wind chill making it feel like 35.

Regarding city business, the Verona Police Department reported that a bus driver was arrested for O W I this past Thursday, October 15, after reports of dangerous driving. Also, residents are reminded to check the interactive map on the city website to confirm their current zoning district and voting ward.

We have a great lineup ahead starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at both Hop Haus Brewing and Wisconsin Brewing Company, with more music and community events continuing throughout the week.
On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I following a report of dangerous driving; no injuries were reported and the matter is under investigation.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The store is closed right now but will be opening today at 10:00 AM for all your custard needs.
